items.title: Google agrees to settle UK app developers' lawsuit for $353 million
items.summary: LONDON, Aug 27 (Reuters) - Google has agreed to settle a mass London lawsuit brought on behalf of app developers for £260 million ($353.21 million), according to a deal published on Thursday.

items.title: Apple Is Cutting Jobs From the Teams Fixing Siri. Is Its AI Comeback Already in Trouble?
items.summary: Apple just laid off over 100 people from Siri and machine learning teams while simultaneously betting its future on a rebuilt Siri that has already missed its own reliability bar once. Whether this is smart pruning or a dangerous gamble depends on what comes next.

items.title: The Magnificent 7 Divergence: Why Megacap Tech Stocks Are Missing Today’s AI Boom
items.summary: The tech sector looks set for an everything rally Thursday.  Nvidia blowout earnings and a flurry of encouraging results from software companies, including  Salesforce  and  Okta  have reignited the artificial-intelligence trade.  Apple  was down 0.6% and  Microsoft  was up just 0.1%, while  Alphabet  and  Amazon  were also lower and  Meta Platforms  was up 0.7%.
